scope: Consumer verification of the template editor review as decided: the editor (D89 to D96, D98) and the two lines that get a template (D99). It verifies this page and its checks, not production behaviour, a parser, or native accessibility.
supersedes: The record of the same 72 views shown with the D97 version for approval, before the human approved it (D99), and before that the 64-view record, whose consumer line said six rejected pages while the test ran five.
noDigests: This record holds no digest of the page, template, builder, test, manifest or any report. Nothing is locked by hash (D88); later edits to those files are allowed and are not covered by this record.

build.result: Built the offline template editor review with 72 inspected native views. Validated the offline template editor review against its evidence and the template reference.

consumerTest.result: Template editor review consumer: positive, 20 rejected manifests, 8 rejected pages and a changed-output check passed.

referenceTests.result: Template reference: 94 cases passed. Template editor scenes: 9 states and their drawn text passed.

guardRemovalProofs.testThenFailedOn: page-title is in the header but is not in view
requires every authored scene under every condition
do not share one keyboard edge
edges of the visible page are absent or differ from the panel

browser.engine: Chromium, offline, in a container bounded to 2 GiB of memory and 2 CPUs
renderedStatements: No digest of an image is recorded, and nothing is compared with a digest (D88)
browser.limits: Every embedded view was opened once in the first context; controls, the notes and one modal were exercised in all four contexts. Axe audits are of the closed page only, not native acceptance. Firefox and an open-dialog accessibility audit were not run.

visualInspection: All 72 published views were read in full on eight sheets, one per panel, text size and theme, below their native size: no status strip, system dialog, notification or keyboard notice. The deck line on the inner panel was checked in all 36 inner hierarchies: each draws 1 of 16 −1.2 dBTP and none the earlier fixed text. Small text was checked from each view's hierarchy, not by eye.
notExercised: Real typing and caret movement by touch
Inserting a field and resetting to the default
TalkBack, focus order, speech and contrast
